# TBN — The Bittrees News

> Source-linked news briefings covering world affairs, economics, technology and science.

Canonical website: https://news.bittrees.org/

## Public pages
- [Home](https://news.bittrees.org/): Global top three, with optional regional and city preferences. Rankings refresh hourly.
- [Briefings](https://news.bittrees.org/briefings): Public briefings with publisher attribution, source links, key points and evidence limitations.
- [Archive](https://news.bittrees.org/archive): Published newspaper editions.
- [About](https://news.bittrees.org/about): Coverage and editorial approach.
- [Sitemap](https://news.bittrees.org/sitemap.xml): Public editions, published newspapers and public story pages.
- [RSS](https://news.bittrees.org/rss.xml): Public feed.

## Reading guidance
Briefings are AI-generated summaries and may not cover the full source article. Follow the original publisher links and retain attribution and uncertainty. Public rankings are editorial selections, not proof of factual accuracy.

Account, sign-in, staff, settings and API routes are not public discovery surfaces. This file grants no access or action authority and does not override robots.txt, authentication or publisher rights.
